app_compose:
{"allowed_envs":["BACKUP_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID","BACKUP_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY","DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD","DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY","DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME","FASTNEAR_API_KEY","LAUNCH_TOKEN","LOG_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID","LOG_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY","METRICS_TOKEN","NEAR_RPC_TOKEN","ONE_CLICK_API_KEY","PORTAL_VERIFY_SECRET","POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD","POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD","POSTGRES_PASSWORD","POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD","SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEYS","TELEMETRY_TOKEN"],"docker_compose_file":"name: near-intents-agent-api

# Docker sends records without exposing its metadata directory or API to telemetry.
x-logging: &logging
  driver: syslog
  options:
    syslog-address: udp://10.89.1.2:1514
    syslog-format: rfc5424micro
    tag: 'naa/{{index .ContainerLabels "com.docker.compose.service"}}'
    mode: non-blocking
    max-buffer-size: 1m
    cache-max-size: 10m
    cache-max-file: "2"

# Anyone can encrypt an env to the app's public env key, so a host could swap sealed values.
# Every service that reads one starts through this check: the sealed LAUNCH_TOKEN must hash to
# the measured LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256, or the service exits before it reads anything else.
x-launch-token: &launch-token
  - sh
  - -c
  - |-
    [ "$$(printf %s "$$LAUNCH_TOKEN" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$$LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256" ] || {
      echo 'launch token does not match the measured compose' >&2
      exit 78
    }
    unset LAUNCH_TOKEN
    exec "$$@"
  - launch-token

# The server image has no shell, so Node preloads the same check before the entry module.
x-node-launch-token: &node-launch-token
  - node
  - --import
  - /app/launch-token.mjs

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18-trixie@sha256:5a5a84b19854a9ffaa54082c166ff4ec27473a361e496e5ea167f298f2da9722
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    user: "999:999"
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    stop_grace_period: 60s
    pids_limit: 320
    mem_limit: 2g
    shm_size: 512m
    tmpfs:
      - /var/run/postgresql:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=1m,uid=999,gid=999,mode=0775
      - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777
    networks:
      - database
    entrypoint: *launch-token
    command:
      - docker-entrypoint.sh
      - postgres
      - -c
      - max_connections=250
      - -c
      - shared_buffers=512MB
      - -c
      - effective_cache_size=1536MB
      - -c
      - maintenance_work_mem=128MB
      - -c
      - idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=300s
      - -c
      - log_min_duration_statement=500ms
      - -c
      - log_parameter_max_length=0
      - -c
      - "log_line_prefix=naa-pg %e "
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: near_intents_agent_api
      POSTGRES_USER: near_intents_agent_api
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN: "${LAUNCH_TOKEN:?LAUNCH_TOKEN is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256: "a0b62300ea9f4c88f664d96ff290a8253b59950fb2dd1e3e538ab251e51a0e2c"
    volumes:
      - database-api:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - pg_isready
        - -h
        - 127.0.0.1
        - -U
        - near_intents_agent_api
        - -d
        - near_intents_agent_api
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 30s
    logging: *logging

  roles:
    image: postgres:18-trixie@sha256:5a5a84b19854a9ffaa54082c166ff4ec27473a361e496e5ea167f298f2da9722
    restart: "no"
    read_only: true
    user: "999:999"
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    pids_limit: 32
    mem_limit: 128m
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=1m,mode=1777
    networks:
      - database
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    entrypoint: *launch-token
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - |
        exec psql --no-psqlrc --quiet --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
        SET log_statement = 'none';
        SET log_min_duration_statement = -1;
        SET log_min_error_statement = panic;
        \getenv owner_password POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD
        \getenv server_password POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD
        \getenv backup_password POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD
        SELECT format('CREATE ROLE %I LOGIN', name)
          FROM unnest(ARRAY['naa_owner', 'naa_server', 'naa_backup']) AS name
          WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = name) \gexec
        ALTER ROLE naa_owner PASSWORD :'owner_password';
        ALTER ROLE naa_server PASSWORD :'server_password';
        ALTER ROLE naa_backup PASSWORD :'backup_password';
        ALTER DATABASE near_intents_agent_api OWNER TO naa_owner;
        SELECT format('ALTER SCHEMA %I OWNER TO naa_owner', nspname)
          FROM pg_namespace
          WHERE nspname = 'drizzle' AND nspowner <> 'naa_owner'::regrole \gexec
        SELECT format('ALTER TABLE %I.%I OWNER TO naa_owner', n.nspname, c.relname)
          FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
          WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'drizzle') AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm')
            AND c.relowner <> 'naa_owner'::regrole \gexec
        SELECT format('ALTER SEQUENCE %I.%I OWNER TO naa_owner', n.nspname, c.relname)
          FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
          WHERE n.nspname IN ('public', 'drizzle') AND c.relkind = 'S'
            AND c.relowner <> 'naa_owner'::regrole \gexec
        GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE near_intents_agent_api TO naa_server, naa_backup;
        GRANT pg_read_all_data TO naa_backup;
        GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO naa_server;
        GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO naa_server;
        GRANT USAGE, SELECT, UPDATE ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO naa_server;
        ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE naa_owner IN SCHEMA public
          GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO naa_server;
        ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE naa_owner IN SCHEMA public
          GRANT USAGE, SELECT, UPDATE ON SEQUENCES TO naa_server;
        SQL
    environment:
      PGHOST: postgres
      PGUSER: near_intents_agent_api
      PGDATABASE: near_intents_agent_api
      PGPASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD is required}"
      POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD is required}"
      POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD is required}"
      POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN: "${LAUNCH_TOKEN:?LAUNCH_TOKEN is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256: "a0b62300ea9f4c88f664d96ff290a8253b59950fb2dd1e3e538ab251e51a0e2c"
    logging: *logging

  restore:

    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    pids_limit: 64
    mem_limit: 256m
    networks:
      - database
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      restore:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://naa_owner@postgres:5432/near_intents_agent_api
      PGPASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_OWNER_PASSWORD is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN: "${LAUNCH_TOKEN:?LAUNCH_TOKEN is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256: "a0b62300ea9f4c88f664d96ff290a8253b59950fb2dd1e3e538ab251e51a0e2c"
    logging: *logging

  rewrap:
    image: "ghcr.io/near/near-intents-agent-api-server@sha256:3ab95e8b6f5d4abe81b4dc7e5a87e952577c57a740c107879013c871bc45bb00"
    entrypoint: *node-launch-token
    command: ["server/dist/rewrap-secrets.mjs"]
    restart: "no"
    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    pids_limit: 64
    mem_limit: 256m
    networks:
      - database
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      attestation:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    # The field key is derived in the enclave. A sealed SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEYS only lets this

    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://naa_server@postgres:5432/near_intents_agent_api
      PGPASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD is required}"

      LAUNCH_TOKEN: "${LAUNCH_TOKEN:?LAUNCH_TOKEN is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256: "a0b62300ea9f4c88f664d96ff290a8253b59950fb2dd1e3e538ab251e51a0e2c"
    volumes:
      - secret-key:/run/secret-key:ro
    logging: *logging

  server:

    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    pids_limit: 128
    mem_limit: 1g
    tmpfs:

    networks:

      - metrics
      - egress
    depends_on:

        required: true

        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      attestation:

        required: true
    environment:

      PGPASSWORD: "${POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_SERVER_PASSWORD is required}"
      PORT: "3000"
      TRUSTED_CLIENT_IP_PROXY: ingress

      ONE_CLICK_API_KEY: "${ONE_CLICK_API_KEY:?ONE_CLICK_API_KEY is required}"
      METRICS_TOKEN: "${METRICS_TOKEN:?METRICS_TOKEN is required}"
      LOG_ORIGIN: api.agentsonintents.com/log
      LOG_INITIAL_CHECKPOINT: "9329:fc5964cb0851f5fd478dc1a3d9d46c7efd6811db4c93885f5b84c03c3600bd3a"
      LOG_STORAGE_ENDPOINT: "https://ad4826b771c926e267f8d7fe4340cf07.r2.cloudflarestorage.com"
      LOG_STORAGE_BUCKET: "naa-transparency-log"
      LOG_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "${LOG_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID:?LOG_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID is required}"

  backup:

      BACKUP_STORAGE_ENDPOINT: "https://ad4826b771c926e267f8d7fe4340cf07.r2.cloudflarestorage.com"
      BACKUP_STORAGE_BUCKET: "naa-production-backups"
      BACKUP_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "${BACKUP_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID:?BACKUP_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID is required}"
      BACKUP_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "${BACKUP_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:?BACKUP_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY is required}"
      BACKUP_RECIPIENTS: "age1q5s0w738cks4sdfl8mp2y9atchfh0h0dwrm53u3ecmah88yyx3gsnrwsk0"
      BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS: "6"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN: "${LAUNCH_TOKEN:?LAUNCH_TOKEN is required}"
      LAUNCH_TOKEN_SHA256: "a0b62300ea9f4c88f664d96ff290a8253b59950fb2dd1e3e538ab251e51a0e2c"
    volumes:

    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"

    mem_limit: 128m

        required: true

      LOG_ORIGIN: api.agentsonintents.com/log
      NOTARY_NAME: api.agentsonintents.com/notary
      WITNESS_PUBLIC_KEY: "598165a18b588f504e159c0e2573d73983ae22bf15cf80d36902276d63a11101"
      SPONSOR_KEYS: "5"
      SPONSOR_ACCOUNT: "3b1b37648fe7117191356685e4e2a6fbd5c09c1aa1f174222a97fa7be2b6ea53"
    volumes:

        source: /var/run/dstack.sock
        target: /var/run/dstack.sock
      - tls:/tls:ro
      - attestation:/run/attestation
      - acme:/run/acme
      - notary:/run/notary
      - notary-state-api:/var/lib/notary
      - backup-keys:/run/backup-keys
      - tunnel-key:/run/tunnel-key
      - secret-key:/run/secret-key
      - witness:/run/witness:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:

        - node
        - -e
        - "require('node:http').get({ socketPath: '/run/attestation/attestation.sock', path: '/health' }, (r) => process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1)).on('error', () => process.exit(1))"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    logging: *logging

  # Caddy only looks the account up by its key; this registers it with Let's Encrypt first, signing

  acme-register:
    image: "ghcr.io/near/near-intents-agent-api-attestation@sha256:51ef80f534c3b2737a3e9abec08adbbf33fe38b33ef82f194ed298299bb2d1c4"
    restart: on-failure:10
    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    pids_limit: 16
    mem_limit: 64m
    networks:
      - egress
    depends_on:
      attestation:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    entrypoint: ["node", "dist/register.mjs"]
    # With the CA unreachable, the account Caddy already stored lets it serve the certificate it holds.
    environment:
      ACME_DIRECTORY: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
      ACME_REGISTRATION: /tls/caddy/acme/acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org-directory/users/default/default.json
    volumes:
      - acme:/run/acme:ro
      - tls:/tls:ro

    read_only: true
    user: "1000:1000"

    pids_limit: 64
    mem_limit: 128m
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=1m,mode=1777
    # A new namespace inherits the host's forwarding, which Docker turns on; with it, the tunnel's
    # peer could route past the geofence to tls.
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.ip_forward: 0
    networks:
      - edge-public
      - edge
    volumes:
      - witness:/run/witness
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "bash", "-c", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8405"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
